description: Use it when the person asks for deals, specials, discounts or last-minute offers. It answers discounted departures of this site's yachts, read from the live inventory: only a discount the source itself states (a special, or a price under its list price), never a computed gap; by default from tomorrow to 30 days ahead, leaving out a departure the yacht's calendar shows taken. One row per yacht: its page link (the id get_yacht and request_quote take), a photo and its departures, each with its dates, every route it leaves on, nights, price, list price, mandatory extras and saving, in the order asked. Narrow with the same typed filters as search_yachts. When none match, the rows are the nearest deals and nearest says what was widened. Paged: total and cursor. For given days whatever the price, call search_yachts.

An unknown place is refused; nothing there answers the nearest place around it.
